scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is proved by a complete characterization of the possible white complements and is exhaustively replayed on all complete-multipartite part-size types of order at most eight. Novelty is best-of-knowledge from targeted current literature and published-finding searches; those searches cannot exclude an unindexed or differently phrased prior equivalent. Standard zero forcing only is covered. No independent audit, formal proof, or expert attestation has been performed.
title: Exact zero forcing polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
